Dog cancer veterinarians discuss what to do if your dog was diagnosed with cancer. Cancer is the #1 killer of dogs around the world and this channel has been producing videos to help dog lovers since 2008. "Dog Cancer Answers" is our podcast.  
New videos are released regularly. Subscribe today! If you would like to ask a dog cancer related question for one of our expert veterinarians to answer on a future Q&A episode, call our Listener Line at 808-868-3200.
